(import (scheme base)

;; Stack VM interpreter
(define (run-stack-vm instructions)
  ;; Return the final state of the stack
  (fold-left
   (lambda (state instruction)
     (case (car instruction)
       ((push) (cons (cadr instruction) state))
       ((pop) (if (null? state)
                  '(error)
                  (cdr state)))
       ((add mul) (if (< (length state) 2)
                      '(error)
                      (let* ((a (car state))
                             (b (cadr state))
                             (result (if (eq? (car instruction) 'add')
                                         (+ a b)
                                         (* a b))))
                        (cons result (cddr state)))))
       ((dup) (if (null? state)
                  '(error)
                  (cons (car state) state)))
       ((swap) (if (< (length state) 2)
                   '(error)
                   (let ((a (car state))
                         (b (cadr state)))
                     (cons b (cons a (cddr state))))))
       (else (list (car state))))) '()))
